_editorial: EDITORIAL CROSSWALK, HAND-AUTHORED. This file is a judgement, not a computation and not an official mapping. Nothing published by the Ville de Paris states which arrondissement délégation covers which Budget Participatif thématique. The theme-to-délégation column is the author's reading of free-text délégation wording. The theme-to-Direction column is inferred from what the city actually did in the 7e, and is regenerated from data/pipeline.json when the data changes. Correct it in place when a better source appears; never generate it from a script.

thematique_source.note: The list is exactly the thématique values present on 7e operations. A new value appearing upstream will not be in this file until a person adds it.

delegation_source.note: Délégation wording is quoted verbatim and never translated. The dataset predates the March 2026 municipal elections, so it describes the 2020-2026 mandate. Holders are not named in this file: use the source dataset, and do not present a holder until the mairie site has been checked.

direction_source.method: Most frequent direction_pilote_operation across Budget Participatif operations in the 7e for that thématique.
direction_source.note: Below the sample floor of 5 operations the cell states that it is too few and names no Direction.
